system.description:
Gained at Level 8.

Cost: 3 Bloodloss (Maximum Health)

You manifest a crown above your head. It lasts for 5 Rounds or until the end of the engagement. While active, for every 1 Mana you expend, the crown gains one charge (a bloody gemstone). You can expend gemstones in one of three ways:

  • Before making an attack roll: +1 per gemstone to the roll.
  • Dealing damage: +3 per gemstone to any source of damage you inflict.
  • Before an ability that requires the target to roll against your Potency: raise your Potency by 1 per gemstone (max +3).

The crown vanishes early if you enter Last Breaths.
